question: Matki dance is the famous folk dance associated with which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Matki dance** is a traditional folk dance form from Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• This dance is performed primarily by the **womenfolk of the Malwa region** of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The dance is characterized by the intricate balancing of **earthen pots (Matkis)** on the head.
 
• It is generally performed on **festive occasions and social gatherings**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Folk Dances of Other States:**

 
 
• **Punjab:** Punjab is famous for its energetic dance forms like **Bhangra and Gidda**. Bhangra is a vibrant dance performed by men, while Gidda is performed by women.
 
• **Gujarat:** Gujarat is renowned for its colorful dance forms such as **Garba and Dandiya Raas**. These dances are performed during the Navratri festival.
 
• **Maharashtra:** Lavani is a popular folk dance of Maharashtra known for its powerful rhythm and sensuous movements. It is performed to the beats of traditional music.
 
 
 
• **Matki Dance:**
 
 
• Matki dance involves women dressing in traditional attire and performing graceful movements while balancing earthen pots on their heads.
 
• The performance often includes multiple participants and may involve the stacking of pots to showcase skill and balance.
 
• The dance is a celebration of femininity, grace, and the cultural heritage of the Malwa region.
 
• It is an integral part of various cultural and social events, including weddings and festivals.
